In the upcoming NFL football game between Raiders and Jets, scheduled for November 1 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Jets" if the Jets win the game by 8 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Raiders".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Chargers and Rams, scheduled for November 1 at 4:05 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Chargers" if the Chargers win the game by 3 or more points.

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Patriots and Dolphins, scheduled for November 1 at 4:25 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Patriots" if the Patriots win the game by 15 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Dolphins".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
